Subject: Exceptional Service at Your Hotel - A Note of Appreciation

Dear Hotel Manager,

I hope this email finds you well.

I am writing to express my sincere gratitude for the outstanding service I experienced during my recent stay at your hotel. From the moment I arrived, the staff went above and beyond to ensure my comfort and satisfaction.

I would like to specifically highlight the efforts of [Employee Name 1] and [Employee Name 2]. Their attentiveness, professionalism, and warm hospitality truly made my stay memorable. It is rare to encounter such genuine care and dedication, and it significantly enhanced my overall experience.

Because of the exceptional level of service provided by your team, I would highly recommend your hotel to my peers and colleagues. I look forward to returning in the future and hope to see the same high standards maintained.

Thank you again for a wonderful stay.

Best regards,

[Your Name]
[Your Contact Information]
